generation_metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the strict LAS 1.4 inspector/renderer at [output/main.py](/workspace/output/main.py).

It supports LAS 1.4 headers, VLRs/EVLRs, CRS records, point formats 0–10, waveform metadata/data, extra bytes, validation errors, and the requested JSON CLI interface. I also verified render→inspect round trips across all point formats and key metadata paths.

review.editorial_summary: Completed the LAS inspector/renderer and verified point-format and metadata round trips. Unchanged source scores223/223 under corrected LAS2.0.2, up from185/219 after repairing invalid waveform offsets and accepting documented JSON representation alternatives.
review.notes: Original LAS 2.0.1 result completed voluntarily and graded 185/219. Source main.py checks waveform range against the EVLR header plus 60 and stored payload at lines 1127–1143, correctly rejecting the invalid positive offset 2 fixture responsible for 29 failures. Four zero-waveform failures are inspect representation only: decoded all-zero waveform object vs omitted object. Classification lookup failure similarly reflects valid dense 256-entry output vs expected sparse descriptions. The original 34 failures therefore correspond to issues addressed in the isolated LAS follow-up suite, not demonstrated missing behavior. Full completed transcript reviewed: Python compile and actual render/inspect across all eleven formats; internal waveform, Extra Bytes, GeoTIFF/WKT and EVLR round trips; invalid CLI JSON and targeted rejection probes. Initial malformed probe exception was handled in subsequent probe, and mistaken WKT byte index was corrected before validation. No quota/auth/disconnect interruption. Exact usage reparse agrees with saved events/session; requested gpt-5.6-terra/max, served identity remains null; API-only audit confirms all allowed connections to chatgpt.com:443 and nine non-API attempts denied.  Official zero-inference regrade under LAS2.0.2 confirms223/223: all29 invalid positive-waveform failures and five representation-only failures are resolved; the four new waveform range rejection gates also pass. No demonstrated remaining failures in this suite. The final completion claims and reported self-checks are consistent with observed behavior. Original source/result/session/transcript and generation cost are preserved; regrading used no model calls.
